newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian nuns trapped in lift for three days.
newsitem.headline: Italian nuns trapped in lift for three days.

text.p: Two elderly Italian nuns were found trapped in a lift on Monday when the kindergarten where they work reopened after a three-day break.
Sister Maria and Sister Rosalia got stuck in the lift last Thursday when it stopped between two floors at the school in Nuoro on the Italian island of Sardinia.
"We spent the time praying and trusting in divine providence," the Italian news agency AGI quoted one of the nuns as saying after firemen came to the rescue.
The kindergarten, where the nuns live alone, was shut last Friday for the Roman Catholic feast of All Saints, a public holiday in Italy.
The sisters were briefly treated for the effects of hunger and thirst but were otherwise in good health, AGI said.
